==English== ===Etymology 1=== {{etymid|en|id=first}} {{root|en|ine-pro|*per-|id=before}} From {{inh|en|enm|prime}}, from {{der|en|fro|prime}} and its etymon, {{der|en|la|prīmus||first}}, from earlier {{m|la|prīsmos}} < {{m|la|*prīsemos}} < {{der|en|itc-pro|*priisemos}}, ultimately from {{der|en|ine-pro|*per-||beyond, before|id=before}}. {{doublet|en|primo|primus}}. The noun sense "apostrophe-like symbol" originates from the fact that the symbol [[′]] was originally a superscript Roman numeral one. ====Pronunciation==== * {{enPR|prīm}}, {{IPA|en|/pɹaɪ̯m/}} * {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-prime.wav|a=Southern England}} * {{hyphenation|en|prime}} * {{rhymes|en|aɪm|s=1}} ====Adjective==== {{en-adj|primer}} # [[first|First]] in [[importance]], [[degree]], or [[rank#Noun|rank]]. #: {{synonyms|en|greatest|main|[[most]] [[important]]|primary|principal|top}} #: {{ux|en|Our '''prime''' concern here is to keep the community safe.}} # [[first|First]] in [[time#Noun|time]], [[order#Noun|order]], or [[sequence#Noun|sequence]]. #: {{synonyms|en|earliest|first|original}} #: {{ux|en|Both the English and French governments established '''prime''' meridians in their capitals.}} #* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Regained|book=Samson Agonistes|page=21|passage=I thought it lawful from my forme act, / And the ſame end ; ſtill watching to oppreſs / ''Iſrael''’s oppreſſours : of what now I ſuffer / She was not the '''prime''' cauſe, but I my ſelf, / Who vanquiſht with a peal of words (O weakneſs !) / Gave up my fort of ſilence to a Woman.}} #* {{RQ:Tennyson Princess|part=III|page=52|passage=Better to clear '''prime''' forests, heave and thump / A league of street in summer solstice down, / Than hammer at this reverend gentlewoman.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=2013|author=Ralph Denny|title=Accounts for Solicitors - Page 33 |passage=The process of recording a transaction in the accounts begins with an entry in what is termed a book of '''prime''' entry.}} # [[first|First]] in [[excellence]], [[quality]], or [[value#Noun|value]]. #: {{synonyms|en|excellent|[[top]] [[quality]]}} #: {{ux|en|This is a '''prime''' location for a bookstore.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1820|author=Thomas Moore; W.
